effects.description: [DON!! x1] [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] Draw 1 card when your opponent activates an Event.
conditions: You have 1 DON!! card attached to your Leader
Your opponent activates an Event card
steps: When your opponent activates an Event card, draw 1 card from your deck
notes: This effect only works once per turn
You don't need to activate this effect manually — it happens automatically when your opponent activates an Event
This effect only works while your Leader has 1 DON!! attached
